primary_workload: Q1 one RHS per material; recorded setup plus warmed accepted solve; process-cold ranking is not measured
cost_scope: Shared material/base/coercivity setup + entire capture constructor including warmups/host binding + original solver + extra residual/error/finite acceptance; field/bitwise QA, copy/profile diagnostics, source IO, interpreter startup excluded
backend_selection: Use pre-execution frozen selection direct at both grids; do not reselect from confirmation
prior_denominator: For each material take lowest Q1 median total of accuracy/work/bitwise-passing eager/full_graph/segmented; ratio of arithmetic mean selected costs to arithmetic mean these best prior case costs
gate: All108 global entry checks before anyfullsolver; allfullfields bitwiseeager and entire statusdict equal; residual<=1e-5, evaluatederror<=1e-3; selectedscreenQ1 savings>=5% at BOTH GRIDS and each individual regression<=10%; only then same16 development confirmation with frozenmapping and identicalgate
capture_contract: Explicit warmed nondefault stream + caller waits and synchronization; raw capture(global), no pool hint/private pool; no GC or allocator/global configuration changes; serial; no fallback on uncertain capture failure
diagnostic_scope: Context copy setup includes profiling/buffer/stream construction, raw copy uses existing buffer/stream: totals alone are not causal attribution; cProfile collection/cache entries provide measured diagnostic contribution only
